messages:
zoe_cs: Quick heads-up 1 OrchidMed procurement paused onboarding. Their security team marked our vendor form as missing a tenant-level opt-out for persistent embeddings when content may include direct identifiers.

michael_eng: can you paste their exact ask?

zoe_cs: they wrote: 
```
Requirement: Ability to opt out of storing embeddings generated from content containing direct identifiers (SSN, national id, bank acct). Must provide enforcement proof for procurement.
```

tara_legal: we can offer a DPA addendum + short attestation mapped to SOC2 controls. legal needs a technical mitigation and timeline to include in the addendum.

michael_eng: fastest mitigation: API-level opt-out that prevents persistence and emits an immutable audit event. Example param: {"persist_embeddings": false}. Server returns ephemeral vectors only. Can ship behind feature flag.

edan_prod: product question: enterprise-only toggle via Account Ops or public API param gated by auth?

michael_eng: recommend enterprise-managed tenant setting initially; API param optional but restricted. implementation ETA ~7 business days if prioritized (small sprint).

tara_legal: great. I'll draft the addendum referencing the opt-out control plus a 90-day roadmap to full KMS-scoped retention policies. Need a one-page SOC2 attestation template too.

onboard-bot: ticket ONB-4410 moved to "blocked: vendor retention requirement" 1 eskew ETA 7 business days.

zoe_cs: I'll tell OrchidMed we have an interim control + legal draft in one week. @michael_eng please own engineering tasks; @tara_legal owns contract.

michael_eng: owning eng. will create PRD, tests: (1) requests with flag do not persist, (2) audit row exists, (3) feature flag gating.

tara_legal: will share addendum draft and attestation once eng confirms acceptance criteria.

zoe_cs: thanks team 1 I'll follow up with procurement and push for acceptance of the interim control. :thumbsup:
